observations.boundary_device: Whitespace between many graphic forms; no uniform repeated divider or separate cell visibly delimiting every putative entry. Circumferential guide lines bound the band, not individual entries.

coverage_notes.left_arc: The band continues with spaced motifs; paler ink in parts makes some detailed grouping less secure. No replacement crop or angle was opened.
coverage_notes.lower_arc: Comparable spaced forms continue around the band; orientation changes with the circle, with no selected alphabet start identified.
coverage_notes.right_arc: Several distinct tall multi-stroke forms separated by blanks; no regular individual cells or consistently repeated entry delimiter observed.
coverage_notes.upper_arc: Clear spaced tall looped constructions and low/angular forms; detached small marks complicate a purely connected-ink census.

observations.graphic_forms: Especially in the upper and right arcs, tall paired strokes joined by upper loops/crosspieces occur as visibly separated graphic constructions. Some small detached marks occur near other low forms. Connectedness or nearby marks alone does not specify one linguistic character.
observations.localized: CLEAR: broad annulus of widely spaced short graphic forms between the outer running-text band and the next inner running-text band.
observations.repeat_limits: Recurrence of similar small circles, angular forms and taller paired/looped constructions around the circumference is compatible with the known repeated sequence. No distinct four start/end markers independently established. Do not label page quadrants as authorial repeats.

scope: One informed image-only observation. Recorded boundaries unresolved; no alphabet count, transcript repair or old semantic claim. Accounting is not perceptual validation.
